objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched or selected (AD1). The diagnostics re-read Stage B's archived official GPU records (zero evaluations) and replay its frozen lane representatives, pooled primaries and benchmarks on the CPU for drawdown attribution; Stage B's sealed selections and verdict are quoted unchanged.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity); P3 (40 % marked DD, 25 % trade principal loss, 30 % banked-capital DD) is analysed beside P0 only as Stage B's predeclared counterfactual arm, never as a change of the standard's ceiling

budget.notes: No search proposals. backendEvaluations caps the bounded non-official CPU replays of Diagnostic B: at most 70 fixed configurations per cutoff (the sealed interval subjects: 64 lane representatives incl. pooled primaries, plus New L0 and N/original), at most 3 engine runs each (diag-core diagnose, canonical evaluate for bit-for-bit parity, one ledger replay). The census and the qualification replay are zero-evaluation archive replays (every request must be an archive hit; a refusing pool).

evaluationBackend.justification: Post hoc report-only diagnostics of a completed, sealed study (brief sections 2-4): archived official GPU records are re-read with zero evaluations; the only evaluations are bounded CPU replays of exactly the fixed sealed subjects of PROTOCOL.md section 4, each parity-checked to the cent and bit for bit against the archived official GPU record. Nothing is official optimization evidence (standard 3.0.0 section 9.8).

chronologicalConsequence: not applicable: a diagnostic with no search, no selection and no chronological verdict (AD2); Stage B's sealed next-interval records are quoted only as retrospective, previously inspected history

deviations.description: no roles and no primary; Stage B's sealed lane representatives, pooled primaries and benchmarks are the fixed subjects
deviations.justification: brief section 1: report-only diagnostics that may not revisit Stage B selection

deviations.description: no search, no earlier-cutoff repeat, no chronological verdict; D23 and FULL are not opened; only the training doors D19 / D21 / D24 are read, for the CPU replays
deviations.justification: brief sections 1-2: no new optimization or candidate search; zero new evaluations for the census

deviations.description: Stage B's predeclared counterfactual policy P3 is analysed beside P0 (35 %) as a report-only view on archived populations; the standard's ceiling is unchanged
deviations.justification: brief sections 3-4 (Stage B's frozen arms, authorized by the user)
